tools.name: estimate_car_shipping
tools.description: Price range for shipping a car in the US: lowest, medium and highest total price in US dollars, plus the distance. Based on Transportli lane data; an estimate, not a committed price. Use this to answer "how much does it cost to ship a car from A to B". Works without an API key.

tools.name: create_shipping_request
tools.description: Creates a REAL shipping request that carriers can bid on. Call it only after the customer has confirmed the route, the vehicle and that we may use their email. The customer is emailed a confirmation link before carriers are alerted; nothing is booked or charged. Afterwards use get_quotes to read the

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: The real carrier bids for a request: each bid with the carrier name, rating, total price in US dollars, pickup window and transit days, plus the lowest, medium and highest bid so far. New bids arrive over minutes to hours; call again later. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_request
tools.description: Status of a request (awaiting_customer_confirmation, collecting_quotes, booked, cancelled...), its route, vehicles, the price estimate and the bids. Needs an API key.

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Cancels a request that has not been booked. Only call it when the customer asked to cancel. Needs an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_shipping_request · Private data: estimate_car_shipping, create_shipping_request, get_quotes, get_request, cancel_request · Public sink: create_shipping_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_shipping_request · Private data: estimate_car_shipping, create_shipping_request, get_quotes, get_request, cancel_request · Public sink: create_shipping_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
